## Summary
The model plane lands as a new `hh-gateway` crate at `home =
model_boundary` — model-blind, dialect-parameterized, behind
`Transport`/`CredentialPort`/`EventSink` ports — plus the `ModelProfile/1`
C0 slice reconciled into `hh-compiler` and the `model.*` ledger classes
completed.

- **`hh-gateway::vocab`** — the closed vocabularies: `StopReason`,
  `StopCategory`, `ModelErrorClass` (kernel `retry_class` defaults;
  `retry_class_override` narrows only), `RetryClass`, timeout/not-found/
  invalid-response kinds, `BlockKind`, `NoticeKind`, `UsageArrival`,
  `Purpose`, `RequestClass`, `RerouteReason`, `SubstitutionKind`, cache
  kinds/outcomes/miss reasons. Unknown provider spellings map to explicit
  `unknown`/`other` with `raw_*` preserved.
- **`hh-gateway::dialect`** — `WireDialect/1`: framing, plan schema,
  envelope fields, auth kinds, `endpoint_allowlist_ref`, streaming
  declaration, `usage_mapping`/`normalizer_ref`, `CacheSemantics` +
  `cache_state_visible`, token-counting method, retry-after sources/cap,
  stream idle timeout, prefix-affecting parameters, strict rules — every
  textual rule requires a complete debt record or the document fails to
  load.
- **`hh-gateway::{plan,codec,grammar,message}`** — `InferenceRequest/1` +
  `ProviderRequestPlan/1` + capability declarations; the `ModelEvent`
  grammar G1–G7 and `collect` T1–T7; opaque blocks pass through
  byte-for-byte; unparseable/truncated tool calls are typed `Unparseable`
  with `raw`, never repaired; `stop_reason` maps only through the
  dialect's declared `stop_reason_map`.
- **`hh-gateway::{attempts,gateway}`** — `AttemptPolicy` as data, the
  R-RT-1…6 driver (byte-identical retries, capped `retry-after`, bounded
  jitter, permanent/ambiguous never retried), `model.call.requested` /
  `model.call.attempt.*` / `model.call.{completed,failed}` with usage on
  `completed`, endpoint admission + budget reservation before bytes leave,
  no secret material in any payload, the `hh-gateway-stub` out-of-process
  binary.
- **`hh-gateway::router`** — `RoutingPolicy{static|role_table}`,
  `ModelRoleTable`/`RoleBinding`, `select(request, &dyn SelectorView,
  &mut dyn BudgetPort, &dyn HealthView, policy, table)` deciding
  deterministically minus allocated ids; the closed `RoutingRefusal`
  (G-1 `NoProfile`/`RetiredProfile`/`AmbiguousSelector`, G-2
  `CapabilityUnknown`/`CapabilityUnmet`, G-4 `InsufficientBudget`,
  `ChainExhausted`, `PolicyInvalid`); `error_actions` is data inside the
  policy `content_hash` with the `give_up` default; `model.route.decided`
  + the `reroute()` payload builder.
- **`hh-gateway::{cache,layout}`** — `derive_affinity_key` over
  `(scope, static_hash, purpose)`, `place_markers` with cap/drop/
  substitution accounting, `expect_cache_state` (conservative:
  below-min ⇒ `uncacheable`; undeclared ⇒ `unknown`; in-flight sibling ⇒
  `cold{concurrent_sibling}`), `observe_cache_state`, LC-1…LC-9 typed
  violations, the `model.cache.resolved` payload.
- **`hh-compiler::profile`** (reconciled, additive) — `ModelCoordinate`,
  `selector_matches` under the closed `Pattern` grammar
  (`exact > range > prefix > any`; `Range{family, lo?, hi?}` per the spec
  spelling), `SelectorView`, `resolve_profile` + its closed refusal sum,
  the null profile, the expiry state machine (`active → expiring →
  expired → retired`) with status payloads.
- **`hh-ledger`** — `model.rerouted` + `model.profile.expired_used`
  registered as `model_io`-origin rows; the pre-existing `model.call.*` /
  `model.route.decided` / `model.cache.resolved` / `model.profile.*` rows
  verified against the payload builders.
